clave: Sustained 55% is elite. The public loses because it bets with no system and no control.
resumen: The majority loses from having no system, random amounts, emotional reactions, betting on hype, and unrealistic win-rate expectations: 55% long-term is elite (verified record ~57%), break-even at -110 is 52.38%, and the public averages 47–49%. The disciplined minority follows a system, controls risk, never chases, and respects variance.
